title: Supertonic 3 TTS VIP9000 NPU offload, compiler workarounds, and target benchmarks

tried_and_failed.attempt: Import Sherpa-ONNX pre-quantized INT8 graphs into Acuity pegasus.py
tried_and_failed.failure: Unsupported ONNX Runtime quantization ops (MatMulInteger, DynamicQuantizeLinear, DequantizeLinear)
tried_and_failed.resolution: Use upstream Supertone/supertonic-3 FP32 ONNX graphs as source

tried_and_failed.attempt: Downgrade opset 19 -> 17 via onnx.version_converter or run container onnxsim
tried_and_failed.failure: onnx.version_converter lacks Pad adapter for opset 17; container onnxruntime only supports opset <= 15
tried_and_failed.resolution: Relabel opset to 17 + ir_version 8 after verifying Pad attributes, then run modern onnxsim on host

tried_and_failed.attempt: Run pegasus.py import onnx without --inputs/--outputs or without per-input --size-with-batch
tried_and_failed.failure: Importonnx.run crashes with TypeError (NoneType has no len); default size_with_batch=False prepends extra batch dim 1 causing Concat_7 AssertionError in ShapeComputation.concat_shape
tried_and_failed.resolution: Pass explicit --inputs, --outputs, and #-separated --size-with-batch True#True#... matching input count

tried_and_failed.attempt: Export vocoder 1D Conv (CONV1D) with symmetric_affine int8
tried_and_failed.failure: ovxlib vsi_nn_op_conv1d.c:op_check:260 rejects (ASYM INT8 activation, SYM INT8 weight)
tried_and_failed.resolution: Use asymmetric_affine uint8, dynamic_fixed_point int8, or dynamic_fixed_point int16

tried_and_failed.attempt: Export attention mask Equal + Where (VSI_NN_OP_SELECT) in vector_estimator
tried_and_failed.failure: vsi_nn_op_select.c:op_check:178 fails on (BOOL8, FLOAT16, FLOAT16, DFP INT8); replacing pre-softmax Where with Add(-10000) ruins 8-bit scale
tried_and_failed.resolution: Replace post-softmax Where with Mul(probs, latent_mask) and pad shorter text_emb with final token embedding so text_mask is all ones

tried_and_failed.attempt: Export vector_estimator in 8-bit (DFP8 or UINT8) with stock libOpenVX.so.1
tried_and_failed.failure: gen_nbg segfaults (exit 35584) in libOpenVX.so.1 transform_merging_multibranch_set_cr_graph_for_no_joint -> cr_op_get_inputs(NULL) on parallel FCL fan-out branches
tried_and_failed.resolution: Preload libskip_mb.so overriding transform_merging_multibranch_merge_no_joint to return 0 via ELF PLT

tried_and_failed.attempt: Quantize vocoder with unfused convnext.9 -> BatchNormalization
tried_and_failed.failure: convnext.9 outlier channel reaches [-2276.2, +1334.6] (std 29.28) before BatchNorm divides by ~200x, forcing scale=6.806 and zeroing normal channels
tried_and_failed.resolution: Push BatchNormalization affine parameters (alpha, beta) backward through embed/Conv, depthwise dwconv, and pwconv2, eliminating BatchNormalization with FP32 max_abs=6.22e-6

tried_and_failed.attempt: Calibrate vector_estimator on Gaussian random style_ttl or single total_step=8
tried_and_failed.failure: Random style_ttl (std 0.5 vs real 0.0625) causes ODE trajectory explosion to [-12, +12]; single total_step=8 sets @Divide_9 fl=18 (max 0.125), clipping 1/4=0.25 in 4-step mode
tried_and_failed.resolution: Calibrate on 32 real Russian ODE steps using voice.bin and set @Divide_9 / @Reshape_1 fl=15 (max 0.5)
